Prioritize workflow/capture metering and compact notice/memory interfaces; evaluate batching, capture gating and context changes under correctness and usefulness gates. This is not production acceptance.

Batching can increase latency or weaken per-item recovery unless explicitly designed

Treat all notice traffic as useless and suppress it
Claim quota savings from bytes or uncontrolled total usage
